notes.title: Pre-Valentines Prep Patch!
notes.content:
Hey everybody! Didja miss us? We're hard at work on the spring event, but with Valentines on the horizon we came to put out a patch!

[h1]FEATURES AND CHANGES[/h1]

- You can now press escape on the title screen to skip the intro
- Boss armor in the Summer Event has been cut in half. Originally if you tried to spam down bosses they would slowly reduce all damage to 0, now the damage is reduced to 0.5x.
- Temporarily removed the sound test menu, with plans to add it back during the coming Spring event
- Load times have been shortened in some scenes

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- Fixed a major inconsistency with Paper Jadon and Robot Jadon's unlock conditions in regards to their costume menu conditions
- Fixed broken respawns in the Valentines event
- Fixed Giga getting stuck at the huge size during the Valentines event
- Fixed players accidentally having character pass 2 instead of 1, everything should be in order now!
- Fixed the Time Attack button breaking if clicked multiple times

[h1]WHAT'S NEXT?[/h1]

We're HARD at work on the Spring event! If you thought Summer was big, be ready for a spring break of epic proportions! Chapter 4 has reached its beta testing phase, with very positive reception within the team. We're expecting a release within this year- likely during the Summer! And speaking of Summer, be on the lookout for minor changes when the Summer event rolls back around! Last year, we buffed Halloween up with the cut Spooky Squad attacks. This year, we-

Actually, perhaps some things are better left as an [b]ex[/b]tra special surprise.

notes.title: Big Ol' Bug Fix!
notes.content:
As we CONTINUE to prep for chapter 4, we found and squashed a handful of SERIOUS bugs that managed to crop up during its development!

- Removed all debug functions
- Fixed the Jonas fight 
- Jadon's ability should properly unlock in chapter 1
- Fixed a desync in Paper and Robot Jadon's unlock conditions

notes.title: Holiday Hotfix!
notes.content:
We're getting ready to re-release the Halloween event, so we're adding a few changes to it that we couldn't get around to last year!

- The Spooky Squad's three members have been given a final stand
- Hellish Hunt has been given a second wave of enemies
- All events now indicate when they'll be going live from now on, as we've made a system to automate the process!

Happy Halloween (in three days), and look forward to chapter 4!

notes.title: Summer Event Ending with Fall Cleaning!
notes.content:
Ever heard of fall cleaning? It's like spring cleaning, but in the fall. We're closing out the summer event for the year and opening up the store page for it soon, but in the meantime we've done a bit of cleanup to prepare for the future influx of characters as we close in on chapter 4, character pack 2, and later seasonal events!

- Completely redid the character select screen. For the time being it's mouse operated, but key controls will be finalized with the chapter 4 update. 
- Fixed a few layering issues introduced throughout various graphical updates
- Gave Blaze her own distinct spawn-in sound effect
- Remastered the main music and shooter music for chapter 3

Also, we'll be hosting our first developer livestream on the 29th to get in touch with the community and elaborate on our plans for the future of Dimension Quest Pinball and other projects! Join our discord server to get updated on when we go live!

https://discord.gg/yVRVEjwKr5

notes.title: Dimension Quest Pinball is Cloud Storage Compatible!
notes.content:
[h1]THAT'S RIGHT, STEAM CLOUD COMPATIBLE![/h1]

After ages of progress being lost when uninstalled or when you need a new PC, we're migrating to a new file system to help store your data anywhere! And furthermore- we've got a few new changes!

[h2]WASD COMPATIBILITY[/h2]

Until recently WASD has been in an odd spot, sharing Q & E with keyboard controls. No longer! WASD is now fully supported with attacks mapped to J, primary abilities mapped to K, and secondary abilities mapped to L! Arrow key controls have also changed, supporting traditional ZXC controls! And speaking of abilities...

[h2]JADON GIVES IT A SPIN[/h2]

For the longest time our plan was to introduce Jadon's ability in chapter 4. After a while of considering and a bunch of new, powerful character additions we've moved his ability to the [i]very first chapter![/i] That's right, EVERY character now has their ability fully unlockable in game! Jadon's scores have been adjusted to accommodate for the sheer power of the Spin Slash, so strive for new heights!

[h3]REBALANCES TO THE SUMMER EVENT[/h3]

Linda and Jonas have been slowed down substantially due to player feedback!
Marlimega can no longer spit Blaze into walls!

[h3]GOING FORWARD[/h3]

To be a bit transparent, the old board designs are starting to feel outdated. With the release of the summer event, the team has come to realize that throwing in a few boards made for each character would go a long way to keeping the game fresh and making abilities more interesting to use! We'll be rolling out these new boards in batches, but in short- [b]every unlockable character is getting an alternate path![/b] Some boards will be shared between characters such as major bosses and the start of every chapter, but expect to go down wildly different paths as each character in the future!

We caught a few bugs quickly, and toasted them quick!

notes.title: The Blazing Summer Event has Arrived!
notes.content:
We're closing out the summer with a big event, bigger than anything we've released to date! Introducing...

[h1]BLAZING SUMMER[/h1]

Take on ten fresh levels with a character who's hotter than ever, Blaze Fairum! She wields a powerful fireball that lets her melt through enemies like butter, and can disperse it into four smaller fireballs that bounce off other targets for maximum burning!

[h2]A Brand New Story[/h2]

Join Blaze's journey to have the vacation of a lifetime no matter what tries to get in her way! Experience her side of the story through sketched art pieces made by Blaze herself as you explore the depths of the ocean and the tops of buildings!

The event will be running until the 18th of September, so get in and scorch every last thing in your path!

notes.title: Robot Jadon's Smashing Update!
notes.content:
Chapter 4 is nearly finished, but after some behind-the-scenes decision making we've decided to released Robot Jadon's ability before the final update! For an explanation as to why, join the official discord server at https://discord.gg/XtJGUHVavG .

+ Added Robot Jadon's ability, which is now unlocked in chapter 2 and is then available across the game.
+ Chapter 2's scores for Robot Jadon have been entirely updated and are much, [b]much[/b] higher.
- Restarted everyone's progress on Robot Jadon.

We hope you enjoy the final update before chapter 4's big release, enjoy slamming enemies to bits with your newly upgraded robot!

notes.title: Costumes Changes
notes.content: Added unique trails to some of the password-locked costumes to add visual flair to the game. For those without passwords, fear not- later costumes added in chapter 4 will also have unique visuals!

notes.title: Halloween is Here!
notes.content:
The long awaited next event is here, and this time it's for Halloween! Rather than Valentine's more "traditional" approach to Pinball, Halloween aims to be more experimental than ever before! 

Help Flash fight back against the undead to save Halloween and put old ghosts to rest, and make use of the powerful Teleburst! Upon activation, the Teleburst allows you to...

- Aim anywhere in a radius around Flash
- Teleport instantaneously, conserving all prior momentum
- Damage enemies in a large area around where Flash teleports

All for 1,500 points in the main game or [i]free[/i] in the event itself!

notes.title: Pre-Chapter 4 Update!
notes.content:
In preparation for Chapter 4's upcoming release, we've released a new wave of bug fixes, updates, and even something special.

[h1]GAMEPLAY CHANGES[/h1]

- Chapter 3 has been adjusted to be easier to navigate while still retaining the majority of its original intended difficulty.

- Paper Jadon's got a surprise waiting for anyone who enters Chapter 3! If you've already beaten the game, it's highly recommended that you replay Chapter 3 as Paper Jadon before Chapter 4 releases.

- Boss health bars will turn translucent when the player is near them.

- All bosses have a dynamic pop-in when reaching their arena.

- Zap Cottos are now twice as large to make hitting them easier.

[h1]MENU CHANGES[/h1]

The entirety of the game's UI has been rebuilt from the ground up to be fully navigable using keyboard and controller, including a new in-game keyboard for the password menu! You can now freely adjust volume, change character costumes, and quit game without ever having to touch the mouse.

Speaking of adjusting volume, the options menu in both the main menu and the chapters themselves has been given a clean overhaul! Audio and resolution are now available universally instead of resolution settings being unique to the main menu, and are split across different sub-menus to avoid clutter. 

Pause menu art for characters and bosses are a bit more stylish, and properly underlap the shadow around the edge of the screen.

[h1]BUG FIXES[/h1]

- Removed a bug where the stock dialogue box was visible in time attack.
- Removed a bug where the plane in Chapter 3 would spin when landing in it.
- Removed a bug where David would speed up the timer in his boss fight.
- Cleaned up a dialogue error in Paper Jadon's interaction with David.
- Adjusted the flippers in the Grand Grass Stepper fight to work at full capacity.
- Fixed an error where the bubbles spawned by the Grand Splash Stepper wouldn't increase the player's combo when hit.
- Fixed a miscalculation that caused the boat to fall much faster than anticipated.
- Fixed Robot Jadon's chapter 2 time attack gold medal being set to 0 seconds.
- Removed an oversight where tabbing out would interrupt the Charles cinematic.
- Fixed Paper Jadon's surprise being available before it was unlocked.
- Fixed an oversight where the camera wouldn't follow you if you fell out the side of 3-6.
- Removed a bug where King Cotto's health bar wouldn't go away if you chose not to shoot him down.

notes.title: Minor Fix
notes.content:

- Fixed Valentines EX not registering progress correctly

- Adjusted the writing to be more concise

notes.title: Big Boss Balancing
notes.content:
To go alongside the remade boards, we've rebalanced a few bosses! Keep the following changes in mind next time you play through the game, and we hope you enjoy the upgraded chapters! We're working hard on Chapter 4, but with everything it's bringing to the table it may take quite some time. Be sure to check the [url=https://twitter.com/DqafO]official twitter[/url] for any updates or teasers!

[b][CHAPTER 1][/b]
- The Grand Grass Stepper has been given a new arena. Falling down no longer requires you to climb back up. To compensate, his health has increased from 10 to 15. This change was due to fan feedback about the frustration involved with trying to climb back while being constantly hit by boulders.
- The arena shared by Mikenze and the tank has been adjusted slightly, the slopes on the bottom are steeper.

[b][CHAPTER 2][/b]
- The Grand Splash Stepper has been moderately reworked. Rather than becoming fully invulnerable when spinning, she instead gains 60% armor and moves 100% faster while spinning. This was done in response to feedback by fans and the dev team finding the boss tedious due to how often they went invulnerable.
- Charles has been given a new clapping attack. This attack knocks the player away from him, but spawns a sand rock from the small island in the center, and this rock can be sent back at Charles to knock him out of his anger state! Much like the Grand Splash Stepper, this was done in response to feedback of the boss being far too difficult and tedious.

[b][CHAPTER 3][/b]
- The helicopter moves very slightly slower, about 5%.
- David now has a new attack in the form of throwing a straight line of potions at the player. This was added due to the David fight being less dynamic than originally intended.

[b][BUG FIXES & ADJUSTMENTS][/b]
- Fixed a common bug where skipping dialogue would sometimes leave the left side character face remaining until the next cutscene would occur
- Fixed a bug where a boss's health bar and pause screen would appear sooner than expected
- Added introduction cutscenes to the Grand Grass and Grand Splash Stepper minibosses
- Fixed a rare bug where David's right arm would be permanently stuck, preventing him from attacking with it

notes.title: The Reduction Update!
notes.content:
April fools is done and so is Dragon Mode, but to make up for it we've done some behind the scenes work. Most of chapter 1 and some of chapter 2 has been redone to improve consistency, smoothen the difficulty of certain boards, and reduce the overall file size of the game dramatically!

- Changed 1-1 to have a more consistent plunger and slightly more room to move.
- Changed 1-2 to lower the top two steppers and provide provide visual consistency with other chapters. More changes coming with Chapter 4 around June.

- Changed 2-1 for greater consistency, players can now launch straight from the plunger into 2-2.
- Changed 2-2 to make the exit slightly wider for easier progress to 2-3. The board overall is also slightly wider.

- Added a new section for the main menu options. You can now set your game's target framerate to 30, 60, 90, 120, or as high as your computer can take it.

- Menu animations have been added for the sake of smoothness and making things less static overall.

- If you've unlocked Valentines, the bonus event is still active and will remain active indefinitely.

notes.title: Minor EX Fix
notes.content: - Updated Valentines EX to improve consistency

notes.title: Chapter 2 Rebalance
notes.content:
Water physics for all characters affected by it have been GREATLY overhauled!
- Jadon, Giga, and Madrillda now bounce substantially less underwater
- Paper Jadon bounces as much as the previous three originally did rather than at his usual intensity
- Underwater top speeds for Jadon, Giga, and Madrillda have doubled from 2 to 4
- Paper Jadon's underwater top speed is now 5

The aim of this "rebalance" was to make chapter 2 less tedious on repeat playthroughs while retaining the odd sense of floatiness present in its original design. All characters affected by water still have halved gravity, but their horizontal speed has been increased to allow for greater control and faster clear times.

- Charles no longer removes your current outfit when crushing you

notes.title: Chapter 3 Release
notes.content:
After a long delay to upgrade all previous chapters and overhaul the game, [b]chapter 3[/b] has finally been released to the public!

[h1]CHAPTER 3[/h1]

Take to the skies with Team Hero through the brand new third chapter of [b]Dimension Quest Pinball[/b] and make use of cannons and a brand new shoot 'em up style of gameplay to fly higher than ever! Bigger boards than before, more elevation than before, mid-boss cutscenes... And beyond that, we've got another feature!

[h2]CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION[/h2]

A new "Special" screen has been added to the game, and with it character outfits! Unlock more either through hidden passwords or through getting medals for each character! Mix and match outfits to personalize your experience to your satisfaction. Cheat codes have also been added... But you'll have to do some digging online to find them!

[h2]NEW ARTWORK[/h2]

The index, pause menu, and character select menu have received entirely unique pieces of artwork for each and every character and item!

[h3]QOL Features[/h3]

With the release of chapter 3, all previous chapters have been updated with cleaner code and smoother mechanics. The camera scrolls on longer boards instead of snapping, flippers are semi-solid, and dozens of bugs have been patched!

notes.title: Character Unlock Adjustments
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed not being unable to unlock Paper Jadon and Robot Jadon
[*] Overhauled how character progression works. You need to beat at least chapter 1 as Jadon to play as any DLC character, and to play as characters in unlocked chapters you have to beat all previous chapters as them.
[/list]

For example, if you'd beaten chapter 1 as Jadon you'd originally be able to play chapter 2 as Madrillda, Casey, or Giga immediately. After this update, you'll have to play chapter 1 as them first. This is to prevent being able to rapidly unlock characters like Robot Jadon or the planned fourth story character by immediately playing the last chapter as the newest story character, and to preserve the story for the DLC characters.

notes.title: Bug Fixing

notes.title: One final minor patch!
